svg.title: 3dMc proposed desktop workspace
svg.desc: Static design blueprint showing Model, Paint, and Preview modes, a part hierarchy, an original cuboid lantern in a dominant viewport, exact transform controls, linked texture context, and separate save and export actions. This is a design proposal, not an implemented application.
svg.text: A calm workspace. Precise tools. The asset stays at the center.
Illustrative values and states · Original geometric study · See WORKSPACE_SPEC.md and DESIGN_SYSTEM.md for behavior
